title: Payments
description: How customers pay at the counter, when you get paid, and the cash drawer.

cash.title: Cash drawer
cash.description: The cash each counter starts with, and how close the count must be.
cash.floatDesc: Suggested when a cashier opens the counter. They can change it.
cash.toleranceDesc: If the closing count is off by this much or less, it counts as correct. If more, the cashier must say why.
cash.example: Off by {near}: counts as correct. Off by {far}: the cashier gives a reason.

advance.title: Advance payments
advance.description: Can customers pay part now and the rest later? Set it for the counter and for online separately.
advance.counterHelp: When a cashier takes a phone booking or a walk-in.
advance.onlineHelp: When customers book on your web page.
advance.minHelp: A cashier can always take more, up to the full amount.
advance.example: On a {total} booking, at least {min} is paid now. The rest is paid later.
advance.invalidPercent: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
advance.invalidAmount: Enter an amount more than 0, like 500.
advance.policiesNote: Fees for cancelling or not coming are set on each thing you sell, under Policies.

methods.title: Ways to pay at the counter
methods.description: The payment buttons a cashier sees, in this order. Changes reach every counter at once.

cash.name: Cash
cash.desc: Notes and coins. The change is worked out for you.

bkash.name: bKash
bkash.desc: The customer pays from their bKash account.

bangla_qr.name: Bangla QR
bangla_qr.desc: The customer scans a QR code with any bank or wallet app.

card_terminal.name: Card machine
card_terminal.desc: A card machine connected to the counter.

methods.cashLocked: Always on, so a counter can still sell if everything else is down.
methods.needsAccount: Hidden at the counter until a payment account is set up.
methods.turnedOn: {method} is now offered at the counter
methods.turnedOff: {method} is no longer offered at the counter
methods.previewNote: The first button is picked for them.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.description: When we send the money we hold for you (online payments) to your bank.
payouts.dailyDesc: Each day's money, sent the next working day.
payouts.weeklyDesc: The week's money, on the day you choose.
payouts.monthlyDesc: The month's money, on the date you choose.
payouts.note: Your bank may take a working day or more to show it.
